selector.champion: Pyomyositis of the levator scapulae muscle caused by Fusobacterium necrophorum
selector.rationale: The patient's presentation of neck pain, stiffness, and swelling, combined with imaging studies showing an intramuscular abscess in the left levator scapulae muscle, supports the diagnosis of pyomyositis. The presence of Fusobacterium necrophorum infection, as indicated by microbiological culture, further supports this diagnosis.
